description: This Java source file defines the class RomAttributeParser, which provides static methods for parsing various attribute strings and byte data related to ROM data handling, including endianess, hex strings, storage types, scale types, table types, byte values, integer values, file sizes, and conversions between floats and byte arrays.

classes.name: RomAttributeParser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse and interpret ROM XML attribute strings and binary data, crucial for reading and processing ROM data configurations.

methods.name: parseEndian
methods.description: Parses endianess string and returns corresponding constant (big or little endian).

methods.name: parseHexString
methods.description: Converts a hex string (e.g., '0x1A') into an integer value.

methods.name: parseStorageType
methods.description: Determines storage type (float, int, uint) from input string and returns corresponding constant.

methods.name: parseStorageDataSign
methods.description: Identifies whether storage data is signed (integer) based on input string.

methods.name: parseScaleType
methods.description: Returns the scale type (inverse or linear) based on input string.

methods.name: parseTableType
methods.description: Determines table type (2D, 3D, X Axis, Y Axis, or 1D) based on input string.

methods.name: parseByteValue
methods.description: Extracts a numerical value from a byte array given endianess, address, length, and sign.

methods.name: parseIntegerValue
methods.description: Converts an integer to a byte array considering endianess and length.

methods.name: parseFileSize
methods.description: Parses a string representing file size, supporting 'kb' and 'mb' suffixes.

methods.name: floatToByte
methods.description: Converts a float to a byte array considering endianess.

methods.name: byteToFloat
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte array into a float considering endianess.
